questions.q: What is coming to Belgrade from Mount Athos?
o: A part of the Honorable Cross
questions.e: In the video: "u Beograd stiže deo Časnog krsta sa Svete Gore" — a part of the Honorable Cross is coming to Belgrade from Mount Athos.

questions.q: Who gave the relic to the Vatopedi monastery?
questions.e: In the video: "koji je sveti knez Lazar darovao manastiru Vatoped" — which Holy Prince Lazar gave to the Vatopedi monastery.
In the video: "Ovu radosnu vest objavio je patrijarh Porfirije" — this joyful news was announced by Patriarch Porfirije.

questions.q: What happened in May at the Temple of Saint Sava?
o: Believers welcomed the Belt of the Mother of God
questions.e: In the video: "koji su u maju u hramu Svetog Save dočekali Časni pojas Presvete Bogorodice" — who in May welcomed the Honorable Belt of the Most Holy Mother of God in the Temple of Saint Sava.

sections.title: Vocabulary
sections.about: Words from the video and their translations

questions.q: koji je sveti knez Lazar *darovao* manastiru Vatoped

questions.e: Iguman — an abbot; igumanom — instr. case.

questions.q: Ovu *radosnu* vest objavio je patrijarh Porfirije

questions.e: Odziv — a response; odziva — gen. case.

questions.q: Posle pojasa Presvete ___ u Beograd stiže deo Časnog krsta

questions.e: Deo (of what?) takes the genitive: krsta.

questions.q: koji je sveti knez Lazar darovao ___ Vatoped
questions.e: Darovati (to whom?) takes the dative: manastiru.

questions.q: koji su u maju u ___ Svetog Save dočekali
questions.e: The preposition u ("in") answering "where?" takes the locative: u hramu.
